i18n/document-review:labels.title: Review extracted text
i18n/document-review:labels.note: Corrections create a new revision. Original files and earlier citations are retained.
i18n/document-review:labels.outcome: Save not confirmed. Your draft is retained. Inspect the latest text before trying again.
i18n/document-review:labels.rebase: Use this revision as the base
i18n/document-review:labels.incomplete: This excerpt is incomplete and cannot be edited here.
i18n/document-review:labels.unavailable: Structured text is unavailable. Try loading it again.
i18n/document-review:labels.same: The latest revision already contains this text.

i18n/document-evidence:limited: Some document content has not been interpreted. Review the source before relying on a complete answer.

i18n/document-format-limits:limits.docx: Headers, footers, images and embedded objects are not read. Rendered page numbers are unavailable.
i18n/document-format-limits:limits.xlsx: Number and date formatting, charts and images are not interpreted. Formulas are not recalculated.
i18n/document-format-limits:limits.pptx: Speaker notes, charts, images and embedded documents are not interpreted.

i18n/linked-evidence:notice: Some linked evidence was omitted. This excerpt may be missing a heading, table header or exception; inspect the source before relying on it.

i18n/image-metadata:notice: This image contains multiple frames or unreadable orientation data. Export a still PNG/JPEG in the correct orientation, then attach it again.

i18n/conversation-input:conversationInpu: This conversation currently accepts text. Document, image and additional Knowledge selection are not enabled here yet. Your draft is retained.

i18n/document-comparison:labels.3: Compare retained text and cells. Unread content and visual meaning are not assessed.
i18n/document-comparison:labels.7: No text or cell changes in this section.
i18n/document-comparison:labels.8: Comparison is incomplete. Some source content needs review.
i18n/document-comparison:labels.9: Comparison unavailable. Refresh to check access and service availability.
i18n/document-comparison:labels.10: Request outcome unknown. Refresh history before trying again.
i18n/document-comparison:labels.22: Choose two documents with extracted text.

i18n/document-export:labels.1: Downloaded copies stay on this device even if source access is later removed.

i18n/document-synthesis:labels.5: AI-generated draft. Check every claim against its sources. Unread content is not included.
i18n/document-synthesis:labels.9: No candidate text in this section.

i18n/document-synthesis-review:labels.5: I checked this section and its sources.
i18n/document-synthesis-review:labels.8: Save not confirmed. Reload the saved review before trying again.

i18n/document-composition:labels.2: Source reviews have changed. Create a new summary to include them.

i18n/work-changes:labels.9: Source access is unavailable. Saved status remains visible.
i18n/work-changes:labels.11: Tests and file writes do not establish task completion.

i18n/work-change-recovery:labels.2: Review these copies before restoring a file. Unconfirmed copies may contain staged changes.

i18n/ocr-choice:labels.1: Applies to newly added files. Saved files keep their original language selection.

i18n/ocr-progress:labels.0: OCR pages saved: {count}. Retry reuses saved pages.

i18n/ocr-mixed:labels.3: Choose up to three languages present in the document. The first is the primary language.
i18n/ocr-mixed:labels.4: Selected languages installed. OCR remains experimental; review extracted text.

i18n/work-surface:labels.3: What would you like to work on?
i18n/work-surface:labels.5: This selection is unavailable or too large. Select less text or check source access. Your draft is retained.

i18n/help-center:helpCenter.empty: No matching help topics. Try a different word.

i18n/browser-manual:copy.hint: Finish your changes in its open tabs. Automation resumes only after you reconnect and approve access.
i18n/browser-manual:copy.unconfirmed: Browser control could not be confirmed. Keep it paused or use Stop.
i18n/browser-manual:copy.scope: The same sites and access policy will apply.

i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.title: Inference endpoints
i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.hint: The service owner provisions endpoints. Configuration changes require a service restart and a new review.
i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.success: Pinned connection metadata verified. Model quality remains unqualified.
i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.allowHint: Enable this exact endpoint for its configured users. Their prompts can be sent to the displayed destination.
i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.stopHint: Block new requests and cancel admitted connections. Work already dispatched to the endpoint may continue; disabling does not undo it.
i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.probeHint: Check runtime and model metadata without sending a prompt. A managed local endpoint may start its owned runtime.
i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.restart: Configuration changed. Restart the service before enabling this endpoint.
i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.restored: Restored workspace: review endpoint access again.
i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.managed: This local daemon has no authentication. Its approved single-user host boundary still applies.
i18n/inference-endpoints:inferenceEndpoi.unsupported: This service does not support inference endpoint management. Installed local models remain available.

i18n/workspace-recovery:copy.purpose: Back up your workspace or recover it from an archive.
i18n/workspace-recovery:copy.unsupportedDetail: This desktop version does not support workspace backup and recovery.
i18n/workspace-recovery:copy.browserUnavailable: Open OffGrid desktop to manage local workspace recovery.
i18n/workspace-recovery:copy.permissionRequired: Sign in as an administrator to manage workspace recovery.
i18n/workspace-recovery:copy.externalUnavailable: This service is managed externally. Use the workspace recovery CLI on its host.
i18n/workspace-recovery:copy.unavailableStatus: Recovery is unavailable. Check the desktop and service details.
i18n/workspace-recovery:copy.statusFailed: Recovery status could not be checked.
i18n/workspace-recovery:copy.requestUnconfirmed: The recovery request could not be confirmed. Check its status before trying again.

i18n/runtime-setup:labels.2: Preparation may download the verified engine shown below. Models are separate.
i18n/runtime-setup:labels.3: Engine ready. Send a prompt to verify your selected model.
i18n/runtime-setup:labels.4: Preparation failed or stopped. Check connectivity and runtime settings, then retry.
i18n/runtime-setup:labels.5: Could not check engine status. Try again to read its current state.
i18n/runtime-setup:labels.6: Ask a workspace administrator to prepare the engine.
i18n/runtime-setup:labels.7: GPU detected; acceleration still requires a compatible GPU engine.
i18n/runtime-setup:labels.8: This service does not support engine setup here. Follow its setup guide. You can still choose a model.
i18n/runtime-setup:labels.9: Checks the configured engine without downloading models or GPU drivers.

i18n/document-cell:copy.note: Retained extraction metadata. Formulas are not recalculated; display text may differ from the original file.
